### The Heart That God Accepts - Truth For Life - November 6
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-6-2023.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 12:20
Points:
- Facing his child's illness awakened David from spiritual apathy to seek God in earnest prayer.
- Even though God pardoned David's sin, the earthly consequences still ran their painful course.
- Instead of retreating in bitterness after the child died, David arose and drew near to God in worship.
- God used painful discipline not out of rejection, but to form a broken and contrite heart.

### Day 59: 2 Samuel 12:13-23
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-59-2-samuel-12-13-23.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 12:22
Points:
- Even after Nathan's dire warning, David pleaded for the child because he knew God's merciful character.
- The crisis humbled David, bringing him back from spiritual wandering into the Father's presence.
- David prayed with bold confidence knowing the Lord reserves the freedom to show grace.
- Once God's decree was final, David accepted the outcome and resumed life in humble worship.
